completeness.why: Every month-wide action now takes its income and hidden/hidden-group rules from shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory (the averages' SQL hidden filter was removed) and both sign inversions use averageBudgetAmount; setZero's hidden exemption is selected by an explicit 'zero' argument. Caveat on data handling, not on the decision: the averages' queries select only c.* so group_hidden never reaches the shared rule, and setZero fakes group_hidden: 0.

interface.why: The preserved setZero inconsistency is explicit, but the parameter names actions ('copy-previous' | 'zero' | 'average') rather than the real variation (whether hidden categories are written), two of the three values behave identically, and setZero must spread a dummy group_hidden to satisfy the type.
